name: Flow G — Automated Ad Account Publishing (Meta & TikTok)

parameters.query: SELECT v.id as variant_id, v.aspect_ratio, v.storage_url, v.thumbnail_url, v.disclosure_applied, s.angle, s.body, s.cta, s.hook_variants_json, c.id as client_id, c.name as client_name FROM variants v JOIN scripts s ON v.script_id = s.id JOIN batches b ON s.batch_id = b.id JOIN clients c ON b.client_id = c.id WHERE v.id = $1 AND v.status = 'approved';
